title: Osaka Itami Named Asia's Best Airport
paragraphs: Osaka International Airport, which is usually called Itami Airport, is getting attention for its good service. According to a report in June 2026, it was named Asia's best airport in a new travel ranking. However, the report did not say which group made the ranking.

Itami Airport is in the north of Osaka. It is close to the cities of Osaka, Kyoto and Kobe. The airport only has flights inside Japan. Most international flights in the Kansai region use Kansai International Airport, which is on an island in Osaka Bay.

Itami Airport has also won other awards. In the 2026 World Airport Awards by Skytrax, a British company that rates airports and airlines, Itami was second in the category for the world's best domestic airport. Only Tokyo's Haneda Airport did better. Skytrax's ratings are based on surveys of passengers.
Itami is also famous for its flights leaving and arriving on time. In the past, it won awards from companies that check flight times, such as OAG and Cirium.

According to news reports, passengers like the airport because check-in and security are fast and easy. The airport is also clean, it has many shops and restaurants, and it is easy to get to from the city.

Other airports in Asia also won awards in 2026. For example, Singapore's Changi Airport was named the best airport in the world and the best airport in Asia by Skytrax. Changi has won the top prize 14 times. And Haneda was named the cleanest airport in the world.
